name: ToolbarEditType
declaration:
enum ToolbarEditType {
  editLayerZOrder = 'editLayerZOrder', // 对应的按钮在 TOOLBAR_LAYER_ORDER
  editLayerRedo = 'editLayerRedo', // 对应的按钮在 TOOLBAR_LAYER_REDO
  editLayerAlign = 'editLayerAlign', // 对应的按钮在 TOOLBAR_LAYER_ALIGN_COPY
  editLayerZoomClear = 'editLayerZoomClear', // 对应的按钮在 TOOLBAR_LAYER_ZOOM_CLEAR
  editLayerFreeze = 'editLayerFreeze', // 对应的按钮在TOOLBAR_LAYER_ALIGN_FREEZE
  all = 'all',
  editScreen = 'editScreen', // 对应的按钮在TOOLBAR_EDIT_SCREEN
}
